fact: APAnews reports Mali-Meteo commissioned PUMA 2025 and ClimSA equipment on 10 March 2026 and can now receive Meteosat Third Generation data in real time for its analysis and forecasts.
The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Mali among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.
